title: Concrete Bloom
description: A dark UK dance-pop cut that hits its peak early then peels itself apart bar by bar. Driving four-to-the-floor kicks frame stabbing sawtooth dub chords that snap and bloom while the harmony slides minor, leaving wide empty pockets where a rap would sit.
